title: Wand guide

rows: Open the HUD, point to a card and use it on release
Move the wand to outline a card without holding Middle, then click Middle, or hold, aim and release, to use it once
Click it, or release on it, for dotted mode: wand movement changes only that card; click Middle to finish
Hold Middle on an adjustable card
In wedge selection, hold and move up or down to change it, like scrolling; release to stop
Release a hold on Switch App
Armed for the next hold: unheld movement can still pick other cards; hold Middle on Switch App, move left or right, release to switch
Go out twice on a card
Outer quick actions: Undo beyond Keys, Space beyond Copy/Paste, and in VS Code Review changes and Stage files beyond the app card
Circle clockwise for next and anticlockwise for previous; click Middle to exit, double-click to swap Review changes and Stage files, hold to stage the selection
Click once after a 200 ms pause

Keep moving the wand slightly while you are not certain about placement so it does not click. Stop when you are ready. The pointer must still be moving; tiny movements filtered out as hand noise do not prevent a click.
Over a scroll area, drag in any direction to scroll; hold still to continue and drag the other way to reverse. A confirmed draggable target drags instead. Release stops the gesture.
Tap, then hold the second press
Drag with the mouse button down; release to drop
Centre the pointer on the main screen and enable mouse follow after the 300 ms triple-tap window; keep HUD and review selection unchanged
Start screenshot selection; move to select the area, then stop to capture

power: All three grip buttons turn off; any single button wakes. Release all before another action.
The light turns off after a minute; pick the wand up to wake it
After 5 minutes, every light flashes twice and the wand sleeps; press any button to wake it

lights.name: Pointer

lights.detail: Green for app review; purple for VS Code file staging

lights.name: Recording
